description: Implementation of cgroups freezer management, including freezing, thawing, and state retrieval for cgroups v1.

classes.name: FreezerGroup
classes.description: Manages freezer cgroup subsystem, including applying, setting freeze state, and retrieving state.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the cgroup subsystem, 'freezer'.

methods.name: Apply
methods.description: Applies the freezer cgroup to a process identified by pid.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets the freezer state (frozen, thawed, undefined) for the cgroup at the specified path.

methods.name: GetStats
methods.description: Retrieves statistics for the freezer cgroup (no-op in this implementation).

methods.name: GetState
methods.description: Retrieves the current freezer state (thawed, frozen, undefined) for the cgroup at the specified path.
